faults.title: Blocked bulkhead drains (Mk2)
faults.description: On the 2011-2019 Mk2, leaves can block the drains in the bulkhead, letting water reach the electrics and damage them. Check the drains are clear.

faults.title: Misting headlights (Mk2)
faults.description: Mk2 headlights are prone to misting up. Auto Express says they're vented, so moisture should clear eventually.

faults.title: Rattling front doors (Mk2)
faults.description: The front doors can rattle. Lubricating the seals may help, but a dealer strip-down is usually needed.

faults.title: Knocking rear suspension (Mk2)
faults.description: Several Mk2s have had knocking from the rear suspension caused by faulty dampers and/or mounting bushes.

faults.title: Fuel pump and power steering recalls (Mk2)
faults.description: Mk2 recalls included a 2015 fuel pump fault that could stop the car starting or make it cut out, and a 2016 campaign for electric power steering failure.
